clarity.description: Evaluation of prompt clarity and specificity
suggestions: Specify the target audience for the product description.

structure.description: Assessment of reasoning flow and organization
suggestions: Use bullet points to outline the sustainable features and selling points.
Provide an example product description to illustrate the desired output.
Use headings to separate sections of the product description.
Specify length and structure of the product description.
Include the target audience and an example description to enhance prompt effectiveness.
original_prompt: Create a compelling product description for a new eco-friendly water bottle. Highlight its sustainable features and unique selling points.
enhanced_prompt: Create a compelling product description for a new eco-friendly water bottle aimed at environmentally conscious consumers. Highlight its sustainable features (e.g., made from recycled materials, BPA-free) and unique selling points (e.g., stylish design, durability). Use bullet points for clarity and aim for a length of 150-200 words.
